verdict.rationale: A government e-service like e-FRRO could plausibly offer system-to-system channels, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows a script-only web shell at the root and a dead legacy entry URL (404). Nothing in it documents system accounts, transmitter or batch programs, an API, or a published enrollment path.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
